shortcut: Full-stack deploy order causing API contract mismatch
detail: When frontend and backend are deployed independently in CI/CD pipelines, the frontend may be deployed before the backend API changes are live. This causes API contract mismatch errors: 404 for new endpoints, undefined fields in responses, or schema validation failures. The error affects production users during the deployment window. Prerequisite: understanding API versioning and deployment orchestration. Requires coordinated deployment or backward-compatible API changes. To mitigate: always maintain backward compatibility for at least one release cycle, use API versioning headers. Fix: deploy backend before frontend, use feature flags for new endpoints, and run contract tests in CI with vitest to verify compatibility before deployment.
